lib.title: Ship's Log
lib.subtitle: {n} plunder-games with a known process · logged {date}
lib.loading: Scoutin' the seven seas for games…
lib.search: Seek out a game or exe
lib.empty.title: Nary a thing found
lib.empty.text: Seek under another moniker or toggle “Show games without exe”.
fav.title: Treasure Chest
fav.empty.title: Nary a doubloon here
fav.empty.text: Strike the star upon a game tile to stash it here.
detail.finding: Scoutin' yer vessel for an installed game…
detail.notInstalled: Nary an installed game found, but fear not: Decoy needs no such plunder.
detail.noteDone: Ye may drop anchor now, yer quest should be counted in yer loot.
detail.noteRunning: Yer phantom vessel sails below deck. Ye may stow this window in the tray.
detail.noExe.title: Discord knows not of this game's exe yet
detail.noExe.text: It cannot be spotted by process. Strike “Chart new waters” later: once Discord pens an exe, it be ready to sail.
running.title: Sailin'
running.none: No vessels sailin' the high seas
running.empty.title: Nary a vessel sailin'
running.empty.text: Inspect a game in the Ship's Log and strike “Set sail!”.
settings.title: Belay ye Adventure
settings.language.desc: Tongue of the crew. New tongues be stashed as scrolls in the locales chest.
settings.defaultTime.desc: How many bells to keep the vessel sailin'. Standard voyage is 16, not 15: Discord quests demand 15 bells o' play, but Discord needs up to a bell to spot a fresh vessel, so exactly 15 falls short of port.
settings.smartTimer.desc: The countdown turns only when Discord spots yer vessel, not when ye hoist sail. To know that, the ship reads only the scrawls about the sailin' vessel from Discord's local ship log; not a parchment is stowed or sent to foreign ports.
settings.autoUpdate.desc: Scout GitHub at anchor and every 6 bells, and haul aboard new gear in the hold. Rigging always waits for yer 'Aye', and cargo be inspected by the royal digital stamp.
update.uptodate: Ye've got the finest vessel afloat
update.running: Sailin' decoy vessels ({n}) will drop anchor.
detail.waitingNote: Discord needs up to a bell to spot a vessel. The sandglass turns when it spies yer decoy.
detail.assumed: Discord hasn't hailed us, but we count the bells anyway.
settings.autoStop.desc: The decoy strikes sails by itself when the sandglass empties.
settings.notify.desc: Send a Windows shout when the glass runs out.
settings.tray: Stow to tray when abandonin' ship
settings.tray.desc: Decoy vessels keep sailin' while hidden in the tray.
settings.showNoExe.desc: Entries where Discord knows not the process yet (they cannot set sail).
settings.dataDir.desc: Where ship's charts and logs be kept.
settings.dataDir.portable: Portable mode: all booty be kept right alongside decoy.exe.
settings.legal: Decoy uses not yer Discord token and accepts no quests for ye. Fakin' a vessel process may cross Discord's pirate code, take the helm at yer own risk.
toast.launched: “{name}” set sail for {n} min. Discord shall spot the colors in roughly 15 seconds.
toast.timeUp: Sandglass emptied, yer quest should be counted in yer loot
toast.refreshUpToDate: The ship's charts be already up to date, Cap'n
lab.title: Galley
lab.subtitle: A hidden deck: hoists colors on an armada of decoys all at once.
lab.count.desc: Vessels be drafted at random, skippin' any already sailin'. Each sails for {n} min (ordered in Belay ye Adventure).
lab.warn: Every decoy be a separate vessel with its own porthole. Too many in yer fleet will scuttle yer rig: each craft and porthole eats yer rations, and after a few thousand portholes Windows may refuse to launch more. If ye abandon Decoy, all decoy vessels drop anchor.
lab.estimate: {n} decoy vessels will devour roughly {ram} o' RAM.
lab.limit: Windows refused to launch new craft after {n}: that be the admiral's limit.
running.more: …and {n} more craft. Only the first 120 of the fleet be shown.
notify.title: Sandglass emptied
